jobs.title: Account Director
jobs.description:
The Account Director will be responsible for leading retainer clients, campaign projects, and new business opportunities for a leading tech brand. 

We are looking for an enthusiastic, solution-oriented Account Director with a strong background in social media, influencer, and cultural marketing. Playing equally significant internal and external roles, you will manage key client relationships, alongside our Group Account Director. 

With keen analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, you will navigate complex marketing challenges, identifying strategies to guide multidisciplinary projects to success. Your leadership abilities will shine as you manage a team, and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. Additionally, you will establish and maintain trusted relationships with clients, acting as their expert for all account service needs, while also driving business development initiatives to fuel growth.

This role is right for you if you are: 

  • Well-organized, a proven self-starter, and able to initiate, prioritize, and drive projects from inception and development to execution and measurement. 
  • An experienced marketer in brand partnership building and creating high-impact social-first marketing campaigns.
  • Have experience with creators and influencers

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take on an influential leadership role in retainer clients, new business initiatives, and leveraging client relationships in the development of business growth

  • Owning the financials for clients, including forecasts, budgets and investments â€“ ensuring that key financial responsibilities are mutually understood and agreed upon and working with the internal finance team to ensure invoices are paid on time
  • Developing team members through training and identifying areas for growth â€“ youâ€™ll coach them for growth and motivate them to develop skills
  • Oversee simultaneous project work-back schedules and deliverables of the cross-department internal team to ensure client needs are met in a timely manner 
  • Manage and track progress across functions, workstreams, and key milestones; oversee cross-functional execution to deliver on launch strategy and ongoing execution

KEY SKILLS

  • Experience creating and implementing social media strategies 
  • Experience running a $2M+ account
  • Familiar with clients in tech, electronics, telecom, or related
  • Big agency background, has worked with very large, complex client organizations 
  • A strong background of account management leading cross-functional teams within a social, influencer, cultural or entertainment-focused fast-paced environment
  • Exceptional ability to analyze briefs, structure responses to complex challenges and deliver projects to the highest standard in a timely and efficient manner, while maintaining an eye for detail
  • Experience interacting with junior to senior-level clients and growing relationships
  • Experience managing a team to effectively achieve results from all levels
  • Flexibility to travel and staff events as needed (10-20%) 
  • Proficient in using Google Workspace (Slides, Sheets and Docs), social and creator tracking and monitoring tools (Sprinklr, CreatorIQ, Captiv8)

Requirements

  • This is a hybrid role, with 2 days per week in office required. You must reside near our New York office
  • 8+ years of agency experience; tech or related industry is a strong advantage
  • Strong background of account management ideally within a social & influencer environment
  • Strong balance of analytic and creative thinking
  • Strong written, verbal communication, and presentation skills
  • Strong understanding of the social & influencer space

jobs.title: FREELANCE CONTRACT: SENIOR CREATIVE
jobs.description:
SUMMARY OF ROLE: 

Weâ€™re seeking a highly versatile and imaginative Senior Creative to help elevate our agencyâ€™s creative output in our Sydney or Melbourne office. Your primary focus will be conceptual development, spearheading top tier creative, and producing work that pushes boundaries, raising the bar for our clients. You will be central to generating innovative ideas that blend design, strategy, and technologyâ€”enhancing our agencyâ€™s storytelling capabilities and commercial success.

Ability to see the big picture and create an integrated campaign across TV, Digital, Social, Outdoor, In store, Activation and any other channel is imperative. 

Proficiency in Google Slides, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma, and AI production (Midjourney, Sora) is essential. 

Comprehensive knowledge of social media platforms and their creative applications is also key, ensuring our concepts resonate and can extend seamlessly across digital ecosystems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborate closely with the senior team members to conceive original, compelling creative concepts for pitches, campaigns, and RFP submissions.

  • Lead brainstorming sessions, providing innovative thinking, strategic direction, and creative problem-solving to develop standout brand narratives.

PRESENTATION EXCELLENCE:

  • Oversee the design and structure of client presentations, pitch decks, and RFP documents, ensuring they are visually striking, on-brand, and communicate ideas effectively.
  • Develop cutting-edge templates, visuals, and storytelling techniques that elevate the agencyâ€™s presentation quality and persuasive impact.

DESIGN EXECUTION:

  • Utilise Google Slides, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), and Figma to produce polished, professional presentation materials.
  • Create infographics, key visuals, and narrative elements that bring strategic and creative ideas to life.

DIGITAL & SOCIAL CONTENT:

  • Understand and apply insights from various social media platforms to ensure creative concepts are platform-appropriate, audience-relevant, and culturally on-trend.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to craft digital content that fosters engagement, brand growth, and positive audience interactions.

TECHNOLOGY & INNOVATION:

  • Stay current with the latest industry tools, including AI-based solutions like ChatGPT and Midjourney, to boost ideation, streamline processes, and continuously enhance creative quality.
  • Introduce new technologies and methods to the team, driving innovation and exploring emerging frontiers in design and storytelling.

COLLABORATION & DEVELOPMENT:

  • Work with account teams, strategists, production managers, and technologists to ensure integrated, holistic approaches to campaigns and deliverables.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior creatives, fostering a culture of curiosity, learning, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Expert-level proficiency in Google Slides, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma.
  • A strong understanding of social media platforms, content formats, and cultural trends.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven creative tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) and an enthusiasm for integrating emerging technologies into creative workflows.
  • Strong visual and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively present and defend concepts to internal teams and clients.
  • Excellent organizational, time-management, and multitasking abilities.

This job description acts as a guide to the key responsibilities and expectations of the role. You may be required to take on other reasonable and ad hoc projects as needed.
